<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <title>Contact | Green Optima</title>

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

    <link
        href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
        rel="stylesheet"
    >

    <style>

        /* =========================================================
           GREEN OPTIMA — DARK PREMIUM THEME
        ========================================================= */

        :root {

            --green: #4F8F32;
            --green-light: #6FAF45;
            --green-bright: #82B95A;
            --green-dark: #18351D;

            --black: #030504;
            --black-2: #050806;
            --black-3: #080D09;
            --black-4: #0B110C;

            --cream: #EEEDE5;
            --cream-dark: #E4E2D8;

            --white: #F7F8F4;
            --white-soft: #EDEFEA;

            --text: #101510;
            --muted: #737A73;

            --dark-text: rgba(247, 248, 244, .68);

            --border-dark: rgba(111, 175, 69, .16);
            --border-light: rgba(20, 45, 24, .12);

            --radius: 24px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           RESET
        ========================================================= */

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {

            margin: 0;

            font-family:
                "DM Sans",
                sans-serif;

            background:
                var(--cream);

            color:
                var(--text);

            overflow-x: hidden;

        }

        button,
        input,
        textarea,
        select {
            font: inherit;
        }

        button {
            cursor: pointer;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           CUSTOM CURSOR
        ========================================================= */

        .cursor {

            position: fixed;

            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            border-radius: 50%;

            pointer-events: none;

            z-index: 9999;

            transform:
                translate(-50%, -50%);

            box-shadow:
                0 0 10px
                rgba(111,175,69,.45);

        }


        .cursor-ring {

            position: fixed;

            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.45);

            border-radius: 50%;

            pointer-events: none;

            z-index: 9998;

            transform:
                translate(-50%, -50%);

        }


        body.cursor-active .cursor {

            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;

        }


        body.cursor-active .cursor-ring {

            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO
        ========================================================= */

        .hero {

            position: relative;

            height: 60vh;

            min-height: 500px;

            max-height: 700px;

            overflow: hidden;

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            color:
                var(--white);

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 73% 45%,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.12),
                    transparent 32%
                ),

                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 22% 100%,
                    rgba(28,59,32,.12),
                    transparent 40%
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    135deg,
                    #030504 0%,
                    #050806 48%,
                    #0A100B 100%
                );

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO GRID
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-grid {

            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            background-image:

                linear-gradient(
                    rgba(79,143,50,.032) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    90deg,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.032) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                );

            background-size:
                70px 70px;

            transform:
                perspective(700px)
                rotateX(58deg)
                scale(1.5);

            transform-origin:
                center bottom;

            opacity: .7;

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO GLOW
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-glow {

            position: absolute;

            width: 650px;
            height: 650px;

            right: 0;

            top: 50%;

            transform:
                translateY(-50%);

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.10),
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035) 35%,
                    transparent 70%
                );

            filter:
                blur(18px);

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           PARTICLES
        ========================================================= */

        .particles {

            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        .particle {

            position: absolute;

            width: 3px;
            height: 3px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            box-shadow:

                0 0 9px
                rgba(111,175,69,.6),

                0 0 22px
                rgba(79,143,50,.3);

            animation:

                floatParticle
                var(--duration)
                ease-in-out
                infinite
                alternate;

        }


        .particle:nth-child(1) {
            left: 11%;
            top: 25%;
            --duration: 4s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(2) {
            left: 28%;
            top: 70%;
            --duration: 5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(3) {
            left: 52%;
            top: 17%;
            --duration: 4.5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(4) {
            left: 71%;
            top: 27%;
            --duration: 5.5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(5) {
            left: 89%;
            top: 57%;
            --duration: 4s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(6) {
            left: 64%;
            top: 78%;
            --duration: 6s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(7) {
            left: 43%;
            top: 35%;
            --duration: 4.7s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(8) {
            left: 82%;
            top: 78%;
            --duration: 5.2s;
        }


        @keyframes floatParticle {

            from {

                transform:
                    translate3d(0,0,0)
                    scale(.7);

                opacity: .25;

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    translate3d(0,-24px,0)
                    scale(1.5);

                opacity: .9;

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO INNER
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-inner {

            position: relative;

            z-index: 10;

            width: 90%;

            max-width: 1450px;

            margin: auto;

            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                56% 44%;

            align-items: center;

            padding-top: 20px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO COPY
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-copy {

            position: relative;

            z-index: 20;

        }


        .eyebrow {

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            gap: 11px;

            color:
                var(--green-light);

            font-size: 11px;

            font-weight: 600;

            letter-spacing:
                .19em;

            text-transform:
                uppercase;

            margin-bottom: 21px;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .8s
                .15s
                forwards;

        }


        .eyebrow-line {

            width: 31px;

            height: 1px;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO TITLE
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                clamp(52px, 6.1vw, 94px);

            line-height:
                .88;

            letter-spacing:
                -.065em;

            font-weight:
                600;

            max-width:
                780px;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .9s
                .3s
                forwards;

        }


        .hero-title .white {

            color:
                var(--white);

        }


        .hero-title .green {

            color:
                var(--green-light);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO DESCRIPTION
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-description {

            max-width:
                530px;

            margin-top:
                25px;

            color:
                rgba(247,248,244,.58);

            font-size:
                15px;

            line-height:
                1.65;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .8s
                .5s
                forwards;

        }


        @keyframes revealUp {

            from {

                opacity: 0;

                transform:
                    translateY(24px);

            }

            to {

                opacity: 1;

                transform:
                    translateY(0);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           3D VISUAL AREA
        ========================================================= */

        .visual-area {

            height:
                400px;

            position:
                relative;

            perspective:
                1000px;

            display:
                flex;

            align-items:
                center;

            justify-content:
                center;

            animation:
                visualEnter
                1.2s
                .2s
                both;

        }


        @keyframes visualEnter {

            from {

                opacity: 0;

                transform:
                    scale(.82)
                    translateX(35px);

            }

            to {

                opacity: 1;

                transform:
                    scale(1)
                    translateX(0);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           3D SYSTEM
        ========================================================= */

        .system {

            width:
                365px;

            height:
                365px;

            position:
                relative;

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            transform:
                rotateX(57deg)
                rotateZ(-28deg);

            animation:
                systemFloat
                8s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        @keyframes systemFloat {

            0%,
            100% {

                transform:
                    rotateX(57deg)
                    rotateZ(-28deg)
                    translateY(0);

            }

            50% {

                transform:
                    rotateX(57deg)
                    rotateZ(-28deg)
                    translateY(-17px);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           BUILDING
        ========================================================= */

        .building {

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                145px;

            height:
                205px;

            left:
                110px;

            top:
                80px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.42);

            background:

                linear-gradient(
                    135deg,
                    rgba(255,255,255,.025),
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035)
                );

            box-shadow:

                inset 0 0 45px
                rgba(79,143,50,.04),

                0 0 40px
                rgba(79,143,50,.06);

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            animation:
                buildingPulse
                5s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        .building::before {

            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            inset: 18px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.23);

        }


        .building::after {

            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            inset: 36px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.14);

        }


        @keyframes buildingPulse {

            0%,
            100% {

                box-shadow:

                    inset 0 0 45px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.025),

                    0 0 30px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035);

            }

            50% {

                box-shadow:

                    inset 0 0 55px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.065),

                    0 0 55px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.075);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           BUILDING WINDOWS
        ========================================================= */

        .windows {

            position:
                absolute;

            inset:
                45px 30px;

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                repeat(4,1fr);

            grid-template-rows:
                repeat(5,1fr);

            gap:
                10px;

        }


        .window {

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.13);

            background:
                rgba(79,143,50,.025);

            animation:
                windowGlow
                3.2s
                ease-in-out
                infinite
                alternate;

        }


        .window:nth-child(2n) {
            animation-delay: .7s;
        }

        .window:nth-child(3n) {
            animation-delay: 1.2s;
        }


        @keyframes windowGlow {

            from {

                background:
                    rgba(79,143,50,.018);

            }

            to {

                background:
                    rgba(79,143,50,.075);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           ORBITS
        ========================================================= */

        .orbit {

            position:
                absolute;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.24);

            border-radius:
                50%;

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

        }


        .orbit.one {

            width:
                410px;

            height:
                145px;

            left:
                -22px;

            top:
                110px;

            animation:
                orbitOne
                10s
                linear
                infinite;

        }


        .orbit.two {

            width:
                300px;

            height:
                110px;

            left:
                35px;

            top:
                128px;

            opacity:
                .65;

            animation:
                orbitTwo
                8s
                linear
                infinite
                reverse;

        }


        .orbit.three {

            width:
                250px;

            height:
                90px;

            left:
                62px;

            top:
                142px;

            opacity:
                .35;

            animation:
                orbitThree
                7s
                linear
                infinite;

        }


        @keyframes orbitOne {

            from {
                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg);
            }

            to {
                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg);
            }

        }


        @keyframes orbitTwo {

            from {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg)
                    rotateX(10deg);

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg)
                    rotateX(10deg);

            }

        }


        @keyframes orbitThree {

            from {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg)
                    rotateY(20deg);

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg)
                    rotateY(20deg);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           NODES
        ========================================================= */

        .node {

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                9px;

            height:
                9px;

            border-radius:
                50%;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            box-shadow:

                0 0 10px
                rgba(111,175,69,.65),

                0 0 30px
                rgba(79,143,50,.35);

            z-index:
                5;

            animation:
                nodePulse
                2.7s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        .node.one {

            left:
                20px;

            top:
                80px;

        }


        .node.two {

            right:
                15px;

            top:
                125px;

            animation-delay:
                .6s;

        }


        .node.three {

            left:
                60px;

            bottom:
                65px;

            animation-delay:
                1s;

        }


        .node.four {

            right:
                65px;

            bottom:
                45px;

            animation-delay:
                1.5s;

        }


        @keyframes nodePulse {

            0%,
            100% {

                transform:
                    scale(.8);

                opacity:
                    .45;

            }

            50% {

                transform:
                    scale(1.6);

                opacity:
                    1;

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT SECTION
        ========================================================= */

        .contact-section {

            position:
                relative;

            background:
                var(--cream);

            padding:
                105px 5vw 110px;

        }


        .section-container {

            width:
                90%;

            max-width:
                1400px;

            margin:
                auto;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           SECTION HEADER
        ========================================================= */

        .section-header {

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                .3fr 1fr;

            gap:
                50px;

            align-items:
                start;

            margin-bottom:
                65px;

        }


        .section-label {

            color:
                var(--green-dark);

            font-size:
                11px;

            font-weight:
                700;

            letter-spacing:
                .18em;

            text-transform:
                uppercase;

            padding-top:
                10px;

        }


        .section-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                clamp(45px,5vw,76px);

            line-height:
                .94;

            letter-spacing:
                -.055em;

            font-weight:
                600;

        }


        .section-title span {

            color:
                var(--green);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT GRID
        ========================================================= */

        .contact-grid {

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                .75fr 1.25fr;

            gap:
                25px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           INFORMATION CARD
        ========================================================= */

        .info-card {

            position:
                relative;

            overflow:
                hidden;

            min-height:
                520px;

            padding:
                42px;

            border-radius:
                var(--radius);

            color:
                var(--white);

            background:

                linear-gradient(
                    145deg,
                    #0B110D,
                    #050806
                );

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.10);

            box-shadow:
                0 25px 70px
                rgba(0,0,0,.16);

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            transition:
                transform .25s ease;

        }


        .info-card::before {

            content: "";

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                450px;

            height:
                450px;

            right:
                -260px;

            bottom:
                -250px;

            border-radius:
                50%;

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.16),
                    transparent 65%
                );

        }


        .info-card-grid {

            position:
                absolute;

            inset:
                0;

            background-image:

                linear-gradient(
                    rgba(111,175,69,.025) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    90deg,
                    rgba(111,175,69,.025) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                );

            background-size:
                45px 45px;

            mask-image:
                linear-gradient(
                    to bottom right,
                    black,
                    transparent
                );

        }


        .info-content {

            position:
                relative;

            z-index:
                2;

        }


        .info-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                36px;

            letter-spacing:
                -.04em;

            margin-bottom:
                16px;

        }


        .info-description {

            color:
                rgba(247,248,244,.54);

            line-height:
                1.7;

            font-size:
                15px;

            margin-bottom:
                35px;

            max-width:
                420px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           INFORMATION ITEMS
        ========================================================= */

        .info-item {

            display:
                flex;

            gap:
                15px;

            padding:
                18px 0;

            border-bottom:
                1px solid
                rgba(255,255,255,.07);

        }


        .info-icon {

            width:
                42px;

            height:
                42px;

            flex-shrink:
                0;

            border-radius:
                50%;

            display:
                flex;

            align-items:
                center;

            justify-content:
                center;

            background:
                rgba(79,143,50,.09);

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.20);

            color:
                var(--green-light);

            font-size:
                15px;

        }


        .info-item small {

            display:
                block;

            color:
                rgba(255,255,255,.35);

            font-size:
                10px;

            text-transform:
                uppercase;

            letter-spacing:
                .13em;

            margin-bottom:
                5px;

        }


        .info-item strong {

            font-size:
                14px;

            font-weight:
                500;

            color:
                rgba(255,255,255,.86);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           FORM CARD
        ========================================================= */

        .form-card {

            background:
                #FFFFFF;

            border-radius:
                var(--radius);

            padding:
                42px;

            border:
                1px solid

                );

        );


        document

        /* =========================================================
           3D MOUSE PARALLAX
        ========================================================= */

            document.querySelector(".system");

            "mousemove",
            function(event) {

                ) {

                    event.clientX /
                    window.innerWidth - .5;


                const y =
                    event.clientY /
                    window.innerHeight - .5;


                system.style.transform =

                    `
                    rotateX(${57 + y * 5}deg)
                    rotateZ(${-28 + x * 7}deg)
                    translateY(${y * -10}px)
                    `;

        );



        /* =========================================================
           CARD TILT
        ========================================================= */

        const cards =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".info-card, .form-card"
            );

            function(card) {


                card.addEventListener(
                    "mousemove",
                    function(event) {

                        if (
                            window.innerWidth < 900
                        ) {
                            return;
                        }


                        const rect =
                            card.getBoundingClientRect();


                        const x =
                            event.clientX -
                            rect.left;


                        const y =
                            event.clientY -
                            rect.top;


                        const rotateY =
                            ((x / rect.width) - .5)
                            * 3;


                        const rotateX =
                            ((y / rect.height) - .5)
                            * -3;


                        card.style.transform =

                            `
                            perspective(1200px)
                            rotateX(${rotateX}deg)
                            rotateY(${rotateY}deg)
                            translateY(-2px)
                            `;

                    }
                );


                card.addEventListener(
                    "mouseleave",
                    function() {

                        card.style.transform =
                            "perspective(1200px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)";

                    }
                );

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           SCROLL REVEAL
        ========================================================= */

        const revealElements =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".reveal"
            );


        const observer =
            new IntersectionObserver(

                function(entries) {

                    entries.forEach(
                        function(entry) {

                            if (
                                entry.isIntersecting
                            ) {

                                entry.target.classList.add(
                                    "visible"
                                );

                                observer.unobserve(
                                    entry.target
                                );

                            }

                        }
                    );

                },

                {
                    threshold: .12
                }

            );


        revealElements.forEach(
            function(element) {

                observer.observe(element);

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT FORM
        ========================================================= */

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "contactForm"
            );

            document.getElementById(

            );

                        );


                        form.reset();


                        setTimeout(
                            function() {

                                success.classList.remove(
                                    "show"
                                );


                                buttonText.textContent =
                                    "SEND ENQUIRY →";

                            },
                            3500
                        );

                    },
                    900
                );

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           SUBTLE HERO MOUSE MOVEMENT

        const hero =
            document.querySelector(".hero");

                    )
                    `;

        );



        /* =========================================================

        ========================================================= */

                if (
                    window.innerWidth < 900
                ) {

                    system.style.transform =
                        "rotateX(57deg) rotateZ(-28deg)";

                }

            }
        );

        .btn-outline:hover {

            right: 0;

        .hero-scroll {

        ========================================================= */

            border-radius: 50%;

            opacity: 0;

           SUB SERVICES

            padding: 30px 10px;

            padding-right: 20px;

        .sub-number {
            color: var(--green);

            font-size: 12px;

            letter-spacing: 0.1em;

        .subservice-row h3 {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: 22px;

            letter-spacing: -0.025em;

        .subservice-row p {
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.48);

            font-size: 14px;

            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .sub-link {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.17);

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            color: var(--green);

            transition:
                background 0.3s ease,
                color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .subservice-row:hover .sub-link {
            background: var(--green);

            color: #071006;
        }

           PRODUCTS
        ========================================================= */

        .products {
            padding: 130px 0;

            background:
                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 15% 30%,
                    rgba(140,255,0,0.06),
                    transparent 30%
                ),
                #080d08;
        }

        .products-grid {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                repeat(3, 1fr);

            gap: 16px;

            margin-top: 70px;
        }

        .product-card {
            position: relative;

            min-height: 270px;

            padding: 28px;

            border: 1px solid var(--line);

            border-radius: var(--radius);

            background: #0a100a;

            overflow: hidden;

            transition:
                transform 0.4s ease,
                border-color 0.4s ease;
        }

        .product-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-7px);

            border-color: rgba(140,255,0,0.42);
        }

        .product-card::before {
            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            width: 240px;
            height: 240px;

            right: -130px;
            top: -130px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            border: 1px solid rgba(140,255,0,0.08);

            letter-spacing: 0.05em;

            align-items: center;

        .detail-index {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: 150px;

            font-weight: 800;

            line-height: 0.7;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.035);
        }

        .detail-content h2 {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: clamp(45px, 6vw, 80px);

            letter-spacing: -0.055em;

            line-height: 0.95;
        }

            color: var(--green);

            max-width: 650px;

            margin-top: 25px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.58);

            line-height: 1.8;

            font-size: 15px;

            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:

            gap: 10px;

            margin-top: 35px;

            max-width: 650px;
        }

        .feature {
            padding: 17px 18px;

            border-radius: 14px;

            border: 1px solid var(--line);

            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025);

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);

            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .feature::before {
            content: "＋";

            color: var(--green);

            margin-right: 8px;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           CTA
        ========================================================= */

        .cta {
            position: relative;

            padding: 150px 0;

            background:
                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 50% 0%,
                    rgba(140,255,0,0.14),
                    transparent 45%
                ),
                #071007;

            text-align: center;

            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .cta::before {
            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            inset: 30px;

            border: 1px solid rgba(140,255,0,0.08);

            border-radius: 40px;

            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .cta h2 {
            position: relative;

            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: clamp(48px, 7vw, 100px);

            line-height: 0.9;

            letter-spacing: -0.06em;
        }

        .cta h2 span {
            color: var(--green);
        }

        .cta p {
            position: relative;

            max-width: 580px;

            margin: 28px auto 35px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.58);

            line-height: 1.7;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           SCROLL REVEAL
        ========================================================= */

        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;

            transform: translateY(35px);

            transition:
                opacity 0.8s ease,
                transform 0.8s ease;
        }

        .reveal.active {
            opacity: 1;

            transform: translateY(0);
        }


        /* =========================================================
           RESPONSIVE
        ========================================================= */

        @media (max-width: 1000px) {

            .services-grid,
            .products-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .intro-layout,
            .detail-layout {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;

                gap: 45px;
            }

            .detail-index {
                font-size: 100px;
            }

            .subservice-row {
                grid-template-columns:
                    55px 1fr 50px;
            }

            .subservice-row p {
                display: none;
            }

        }


        @media (max-width: 700px) {

            .container {
                width: min(100% - 30px, 1240px);
            }

            .cursor,
            .cursor-ring {
                display: none;
            }

            .hero {
                min-height: 92vh;
            }

            .hero-content {
                padding: 120px 0 80px;
            }

            .hero-title {
                font-size: clamp(52px, 15vw, 85px);
            }

            .hero-subtitle {
                font-size: 15px;
            }

            .hero-actions {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
            }

            .intro {
                padding: 90px 0;
            }

            .intro-number {
                font-size: 100px;
            }

            .services,
            .subservices,
            .products {
                padding: 90px 0;
            }

            .section-heading-row {
                display: block;
            }

            .service-count {
                display: block;

                margin-top: 20px;
            }

            .services-grid,
            .products-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;

                margin-top: 45px;
            }

            .service-card {
                min-height: 280px;
            }

            .subservice-list {
                margin-top: 45px;
            }

            .subservice-row {
                grid-template-columns:
                    45px 1fr 40px;

                gap: 14px;

                padding: 24px 4px;
            }

            .subservice-row h3 {
                font-size: 17px;
            }

            .product-detail {
                padding: 90px 0;
            }

            .detail-layout {
                gap: 30px;
            }

            .detail-index {
                font-size: 80px;
            }

            .feature-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .cta {
                padding: 110px 0;
            }

            .cta::before {
                inset: 15px;
            }

        }

    </style>
</head>

                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {

                        entry.target.classList.add("active");

                        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);

                    }

                });

            },

            {
                threshold: 0.12
            }

        );


    revealElements.forEach(element => {

        revealObserver.observe(element);

    });


    /* =========================================================
       HERO VIDEO PARALLAX
    ========================================================== */

    window.addEventListener(
        "scroll",
        () => {

            if (!heroVideo) {
                return;
            }

            const scroll =
                window.scrollY;

            if (scroll < window.innerHeight) {

                heroVideo.style.transform =
                    `scale(1.04) translateY(${scroll * 0.08}px)`;

            }

        },
        {
            passive: true
        }
    );


    /* =========================================================
       CUSTOM CURSOR
    ========================================================== */

    const cursor =
        document.createElement("div");

    cursor.className = "cursor";

    const cursorRing =
        document.createElement("div");

    cursorRing.className = "cursor-ring";

    document.body.appendChild(cursor);
    document.body.appendChild(cursorRing);


    let mouseX = 0;
    let mouseY = 0;

    let ringX = 0;
    let ringY = 0;


    document.addEventListener(
        "mousemove",
        event => {

            mouseX = event.clientX;
            mouseY = event.clientY;

            cursor.style.left =
                mouseX + "px";

            cursor.style.top =
                mouseY + "px";

        }
    );


    function animateCursor() {

        ringX +=
            (mouseX - ringX) * 0.15;

        ringY +=
            (mouseY - ringY) * 0.15;

        cursorRing.style.left =
            ringX + "px";

        cursorRing.style.top =
            ringY + "px";

        requestAnimationFrame(
            animateCursor
        );

    }


    animateCursor();


    /* =========================================================
       CURSOR HOVER
    ========================================================== */

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "a, button"
    ).forEach(element => {

        element.addEventListener(
            "mouseenter",
            () => {

                cursor.style.width = "18px";
                cursor.style.height = "18px";

                cursorRing.style.width = "48px";
                cursorRing.style.height = "48px";

            }
        );


        element.addEventListener(
            "mouseleave",
            () => {

                cursor.style.width = "10px";
                cursor.style.height = "10px";

                cursorRing.style.width = "34px";
                cursorRing.style.height = "34px";

            }
        );

    });


    /* =========================================================
       MOBILE CURSOR
    ========================================================== */

    if (
        window.matchMedia(
            "(pointer: coarse)"
        ).matches
    ) {

        cursor.remove();
        cursorRing.remove();

    }

</script>

<script>

/* =========================================================
   CUSTOM CURSOR
========================================================= */

const cursor =
    document.querySelector(".cursor");

const cursorRing =
    document.querySelector(".cursor-ring");


document.addEventListener(
    "mousemove",
    (e) => {

        cursor.style.left =
            e.clientX + "px";

        cursor.style.top =
            e.clientY + "px";


        cursorRing.animate(
            {
                left:
                    e.clientX + "px",

                top:
                    e.clientY + "px"
            },
            {
                duration: 250,
                fill: "forwards"
            }
        );

    }
);



/* =========================================================
   NEWS + EVENT MODAL
========================================================= */

const modal =
    document.getElementById(
        "contentModal"
    );

const modalTitle =
    document.getElementById(
        "modalTitle"
    );

const modalDate =
    document.getElementById(
        "modalDate"
    );

const modalDescription =
    document.getElementById(
        "modalDescription"
    );

const modalClose =
    document.getElementById(
        "modalClose"
    );


document
    .querySelectorAll(
        ".news-card, .event"
    )
    .forEach(
        card => {

            card.addEventListener(
                "click",
                () => {

                    modalTitle.textContent =
                        card.dataset.title;

                    modalDate.textContent =
                        card.dataset.date;

                    modalDescription.textContent =
                        card.dataset.description;

                    modal.classList.add(
                        "active"
                    );

                    document.body.style.overflow =
                        "hidden";

                }
            );

        }
    );


function closeModal() {

    modal.classList.remove(
        "active"
    );

    document.body.style.overflow =
        "";

}


modalClose.addEventListener(
    "click",
    closeModal
);


modal.addEventListener(
    "click",
    (e) => {

        if (
            e.target === modal
        ) {
            closeModal();
        }

    }
);


document.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    (e) => {

        if (
            e.key === "Escape"
        ) {
            closeModal();
        }

    }
);



/* =========================================================
   NEWSLETTER
========================================================= */

const newsletterForm =
    document.getElementById(
        "newsletterForm"
    );

const newsletterEmail =
    document.getElementById(
        "newsletterEmail"
    );

const successMessage =
    document.getElementById(
        "successMessage"
    );


newsletterForm.addEventListener(
    "submit",
    (e) => {

        e.preventDefault();


        const email =
            newsletterEmail.value.trim();


        if (!email) {
            return;
        }


        successMessage.classList.add(
            "show"
        );


        newsletterEmail.value =
            "";


        setTimeout(
            () => {

                successMessage.classList.remove(
                    "show"
                );

            },
            3500
        );

    }
);



/* =========================================================
   3D NEWS CARD TILT
========================================================= */

document
    .querySelectorAll(
        ".news-card"
    )
    .forEach(
        card => {

            card.addEventListener(
                "mousemove",
                e => {

                    if (
                        window.innerWidth < 900
                    ) {
                        return;
                    }


                    const rect =
                        card.getBoundingClientRect();


                    const x =
                        e.clientX -
                        rect.left;


                    const y =
                        e.clientY -
                        rect.top;


                    const rotateY =
                        ((x / rect.width) - .5)
                        * 4;


                    const rotateX =
                        ((y / rect.height) - .5)
                        * -4;


                    card.style.transform =

                        `
                        perspective(900px)
                        rotateX(${rotateX}deg)
                        rotateY(${rotateY}deg)
                        translateY(-8px)
                        `;

                }
            );


            card.addEventListener(
                "mouseleave",
                () => {

                    card.style.transform =
                        "";

                }
            );

        }
    );



/* =========================================================
   EVENT HOVER MOTION
========================================================= */

document
    .querySelectorAll(
        ".event"
    )
    .forEach(
        event => {

            event.addEventListener(
                "mousemove",
                e => {

                    const rect =
                        event.getBoundingClientRect();


                    const position =
                        ((e.clientX -
                        rect.left) /
                        rect.width) * 100;


                    event.style.background =

                        `
                        linear-gradient(
                            90deg,
                            rgba(79,143,50,.09)
                            ${position}%,
                            transparent
                        )
                        `;

                }
            );


            event.addEventListener(
                "mouseleave",
                () => {

                    event.style.background =
                        "";

                }
            );

        }
    );



/* =========================================================
   PARALLAX HERO
========================================================= */

const orbit =
    document.querySelector(
        ".hero-orbit"
    );


document.addEventListener(
    "mousemove",
    e => {

        if (
            window.innerWidth < 900
        ) {

            (e.clientX /
            window.innerWidth - .5);


        const y =
            (e.clientY /
            window.innerHeight - .5);


        orbit.style.marginLeft =
            `${x * 18}px`;

        orbit.style.marginTop =
            `${y * 12}px`;

    }
);

</script>
